releaseNotes:
## Backup & disaster recovery
- First-run **Recover from backup** wizard (upload encrypted .enc, enter recovery key, validate, restore)
- Large recovery uploads via dedicated API (up to 200 MB)
- Windows/Next.js safe restore: when the live database is locked, restore defers until restart and applies on startup
- INITIAL_ADMIN_SEED must be set explicitly; username/password alone no longer auto-seed an empty install
- Setup gate: empty installs reach /setup and /setup/recover without a session

## Value of Service
- Conference VoS summary total can be entered directly; clearer empty fields and print layout

## Docs
- BACKUP.md updated for Windows restart recovery and upload limits
